    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FamilyExtraction.exists_jointly_stable_dependent_semibrick {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (h : ¬EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat R)) :
    ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))) (g : ProjectiveClass R), ↑s ⊆ stableClasses ((projectiveClassWeight k) g) ∧ ¬LinearIndependent ℤ fun (x : ↥s) => GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑x)

    Failure of equal-class Hom produces an integrally dependent family of bricks stable at a single integral projective weight.
